scope: Preview-only team membership and Brevo invitation transport; does not claim full Teams, shared resource access or verified delivery.

keep: Existing auth context, Paid entitlement, and terminal history
extend: In-app Teams membership and activity in Preview

architecture.reason: Reuses the authenticated Xroga API and database with no new orchestrator.

schemaImpact.rollout: Fresh and upgrade verification on isolated Supabase before enabling Preview; no production migration.
schemaImpact.rollback: Disable the Teams Preview origin flag. Keep membership evidence and tables intact; no destructive migration.

auth.description: Verified bearer tenant context and canonical active individual Paid eligibility protect the Preview route.

tenant.description: Service-only RPC enforces active membership and role within serialized team transactions. Client grants denied; no existing personal resources exposed.

approval.description: Only explicit authenticated Paid Owner/Admin invite or resend may claim a single email.

credentials.description: Reads the existing Brevo key only as a server credential; never records or logs it.

egress.description: One transactional email to the verified account at the fixed Brevo endpoint, with redirects and automatic retries denied.

cost.description: No AI calls and no shared allowances.

billing.description: Reads existing entitlement, does not create or mutate billing records during normal use.

tests.scope: Reject missing or production Teams deploy settings

tests.command: GitHub Actions: Isolated Supabase authenticated browser verification
tests.scope: Real separate accounts, forged RPC denial, individual Paid gating, membership removal, send claims, rate limit, expiry and revocation
Fixed Brevo endpoint, Preview link admission, single attempt and response classification

rollout: Review-only draft PR; a source-pinned Preview requires dedicated Auth, API and storage settings and completed isolation tests.
rollback: Disable the branch-specific environment settings and leave unrelated environments unchanged.
knownGaps: No isolated hosted Preview configured on this branch; actual Brevo delivery not verified.
Shared workspaces, content ownership, collaboration, notifications and AI continuation are not implemented.

blockers: Isolated authenticated acceptance and hosted Preview configuration are not verified.
